title: Qualification evidence
summary: Dev3 remains live-qualified for TLS 1.3 loopback and two-stream multiplexing. Dev4 is currently source/static-qualified: its new OpenSSL stream-count APIs compile against OpenSSL 3.5.5, but the ooRexx r13196/native live suite has not yet been rerun.
invariants: Dev3 observed ordinary live route: CLIENT_OK 42 / SERVER_OK 42.
Dev3 observed multiplex route: CLIENT_MUX_OK 0 4 / SERVER_MUX_OK 0 4.
Dev4 OpenSSL API probe passed for SSL_STREAM_FLAG_NO_BLOCK and SSL_get_quic_stream_*_local_avail.
Dev4 package static guards, JSON parse, shell syntax and ZIP integrity passed.
Dev4 ooRexx/native live qualification is NOT RUN and must not be inferred from dev3 evidence.
